bullets.text: Storm-1175 Targets Vulnerable Assets - **Microsoft** warns of high-tempo ransomware operations exploiting N-day vulnerabilities.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New builds released for **Windows 11** Insiders with various enhancements and features.
Microsoft's Sovereign Cloud Leadership - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Sovereign Cloud Platforms.
AI-Enabled Phishing Campaign Escalates - **Microsoft Defender** reports sophisticated phishing attacks using device code authentication.
Intent Redirection Vulnerability Found - **Microsoft** identifies a severe flaw in a third-party Android SDK affecting millions.
